paragraphs: The father of Rav Shmuel. After his death, Rabbi Abba (I) married his widow, as explained in Bava Kamma 88b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The story’s opening appears in the William Davidson digital text of Bava Kamma 88a, naming Abba of Hagronia as the father of Rav Shmuel. Hyman’s 88b citation and Rabbi Abba (I) designation are retained.

The whole Davidson Bava Kamma 88a paragraph names Rav Shmuel bar Abba of Hagronia and his mother’s marriage to Rabbi Abba. Hyman’s 88b locator, after-his-death sequencing and Rabbi Abba (I) designation remain his account. The digital paragraph supports the local full titles without establishing a new genealogy or equating other bearers of these names.
